in_marathi.name: Samidhaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samidhaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Samidhaa is derived from Sanskrit and is the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology. She is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance. She is often depicted with a lotus flower in her hands and is believed to bring good fortune and riches to those who pray to her.
